start:
Quick start

Create a project or choose a template. Drag blocks onto the canvas, edit their properties and connect outputs to the next blocks. Fill in settings, validate with F7, test with F5 and export Docker or Cloudflare.
canvas:
Graph & connections

Drag an output on the right to another block's input or body. Each output has one connection; a new one replaces it. Wheel: zoom. Middle mouse: pan. Drag a frame: select blocks. Home: fit graph. The top-right minimap shows the entire graph.
answers:
Answer choices

Select a menu block and edit answer options. ID is the unique output; Text is the visible label. Types: transition, url, main_menu, back. URL is required only for url. Row order determines button order. Apply to update the graph.
blocks:
Block library

Triggers start a script. Message displays text; Menu offers buttons; Question collects input; Dictionary builds options. Condition/Switch branches, Set Variable stores values, HTTP Request calls APIs, Finish ends a branch. Code mode exposes JSON. Delete removes the selected block below Apply.
variables:
Variables

Use Latin variable names without spaces, e.g. request_id. Insert values using {{ request_id }}. Choose a type, JSON default and persistence: context survives updates; ephemeral lasts one step. Set max_length to limit stored user input.
env:
ENV & secrets

The project stores ENV names, not values. For Docker, copy .env.example to .env and keep .env private. For Cloudflare, create every value listed inside worker.js under Settings → Variables and Secrets with type Secret. SETUP_SECRET protects /setup. Node.js and Wrangler are not required.
token:
Get BOT_TOKEN

Open the verified @BotFather in Telegram. Send /newbot and set a name and username. Paste the token into BOT_TOKEN in ENV & Telegram, then check it. Never publish tokens; revoke exposed tokens through BotFather.
chat:
Chat ID

Add the bot to the chat with read/send permissions and send a new message. Find Chat ID / Topic ID in settings. Copy the group’s negative ID to ADMIN_CHAT_ID. If getUpdates conflicts with a webhook, temporarily remove the webhook and restore it afterward.
topic:
Topic / Topic ID

Send a message in the required forum topic and find its message_thread_id. Set the recipient’s Chat ID ENV and Topic ID. Leave Topic ID empty for ordinary groups or private chats. One chat can have several recipients with different topics.
webhook:
Webhook

Deploy the exported project and copy its real HTTPS URL. Generate WEBHOOK_SECRET and set the same value on the server. Enter the URL, set the webhook and check its status. TRIGRIX creates paths and secrets, not a public domain or server.
recipients:
Recipients

A recipient ID is used by card, notification and forwarding blocks. chat_id_env references an ENV name, not an actual chat number. Topic ID is optional. Configure these values in Main settings, then apply.
dictionaries:
Dictionaries

Dictionaries contain options with unique IDs, visible text and optional JSON fields for routing. Technical names use Latin letters, digits and _. Edit/create a dictionary from block properties. Saving updates block references and preserves the selected block. Add creates the next numeric record ID.
validation:
Validate project

F7 checks required fields, references, unreachable blocks, output connections and context limits. Resolve errors before export. Warnings identify potential problems. Results appear in Validation and the log.
simulator:
Simulator

F5 runs the flow locally without Telegram. Test replies and buttons; inspect the current block, variables and route. External API calls and real message forwarding are not performed. Restart with /start.
code:
Code mode

Enable Code mode to view generated files and block JSON. The editor has line numbers, highlighting and syntax checks. Saving edits changes only the preview. Regenerating overwrites those edits; export first for permanent code changes.
export:
Export & deployment

Cloudflare exports one ready worker.js. Its complete localized guide is in the opening comment. Replace the starter code in Cloudflare Edit Code, add every listed value as Secret, deploy and open /setup to register and check the Telegram webhook. Docker exports a ZIP: extract it, copy .env.example to .env, fill the values and run docker compose up -d --build. Its localized README explains every step.
security:
Security

Keep tokens out of blocks, projects and Git. Use random webhook secrets, minimum bot permissions and input length limits. Review exported code and back up project files. Revoke any exposed credentials at the provider.
channels:
Channels

One graph serves all enabled channels. Set account ID, unique webhook path, signature-secret ENV and credentials JSON. Credentials contain ENV names, not tokens. Apply changes before export. The validator reports unsupported buttons or attachments.
meta:
WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger

Create an app in Meta for Developers using official APIs. WhatsApp needs Phone Number ID, token, verify token and App Secret. Instagram needs a professional account; Messenger needs Page ID and Page token. Configure the deployed webhook and required permissions. WhatsApp may require approved templates outside the messaging window.
email_cloudflare:
Cloudflare Email

Enable Email Routing and verify recipients. In Cloudflare open Worker → Settings → Bindings → Add → Send Email, use the binding name printed in worker.js and allow only verified destinations. A binding is a resource, not a Secret variable. Tokens for other email API providers must be Secrets. SMTP is only for Docker/VPS.
crm:
CRM

Select a provider and give the integration a unique ID used by CRM blocks. Set Base URL, token ENV, pipeline/status/owner and field-mapping JSON. REST/Webhook supports other services. Stable lead_id helps avoid duplicates; external IDs are stored in crm_refs.
firebase:
Firebase Firestore

Enable structured lead storage and set Firebase Project ID, Database ID (usually (default)), Collection and service-account secret ENV. Store credentials on the server only. Retention days controls expiry. Chat history is not stored. Configure access permissions in Firebase.
lead_export:
Export leads

Administrator commands: /export_leads, /export_leads_today, /export_leads_week, /export_leads_month. Firestore records are read in pages and sent as XLSX/CSV. Sheets include contacts, leads, answers and sources. Old messages cannot be recovered via Bot API. File → Telegram Desktop JSON import recognizes structured cards only.
localization:
Languages

The interface supports 10 languages. Choose View → Language and restart. Bot languages are configured separately in Channels & integrations. Translate user-authored messages explicitly; technical keys and ENV names stay stable. New projects use the selected interface language for their name.
